params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Fiora}} challenges nearby enemy champions, calling out a direction from which she will try to strike their {{as|Vitals|buzzword}}. A new {{as|Vital|buzzword}} is called out after some time or if one is struck.
params.blurb2: Striking a vital deals {{as|'''bonus''' true damage}} based on the {{as|target's '''maximum''' health}}, {{tip|heals}} '''Fiora''' and grants her a burst of {{as|{{sti|movement speed}}}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Fiora''' identifies the {{as|Vitals|buzzword}} of nearby enemy champions, marked as an arc around them in North-, East-, South- or Westward direction. {{as|Vitals|buzzword}} take {{fd|1.75}} seconds to become targetable and linger for {{fd|13.25}} seconds afterwards while '''Fiora''' remains near the target, otherwise the {{as|Vital|buzzword}} will disappear. After a {{as|Vital|buzzword}} expires, '''Fiora''' identifies a new one on her target.
params.description2: Dealing damage in the direction of a {{as|Vital|buzzword}} will trigger it to deal {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' true damage}}}} equal to {{as|3% {{as|(+ 4% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of target's '''maximum''' health}}, {{tip|heal}} '''Fiora''' for {{pplevel|35 to 100|color=heal}}, and grant her {{pp|type=[[File:Grand Challenge.png|20px|link=]] ''Grand Challenge's'' Rank|key=%|20 to 50 for 4|0 to 3|formula=20%+(10%*Grand Challenge's Rank)|color=ms}} {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays over {{fd|1.85}} seconds.
params.effect radius: {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|1200|If Fiora is visible}}|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|1350|Distance for remaining 'near' the target}}|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|250|If Fiora is out of vision, estimated}}}}
params.notes:
* {{as|Vitals|buzzword}} can be triggered by any source of damage '''Fiora''' deals, except those with {{tip|default damage}} and {{tip|reactive damage}} types.
* The {{as|Vitals|buzzword}} are visible to all units.
* A {{as|Vital's|buzzword}} angle is fixed to the champion's model and doesn't interact with its orientation.
* {{as|Vitals|buzzword}} spawn directions alternate in a Northeast-Southwest pattern. Other than that, they have a 50% chance to spawn North or East, or South or West, respectively.
** {{pending for test}} The direction of the first {{as|Vital|buzzword}} upon '''Fiora''' and her enemy encountering one another in the game for the first time is always Southward or Westward. This is true regardless of whether Fiora is in the Blue or Red team.
* {{as|Vitals|buzzword}} will not trigger if the attack is {{tip|dodge|dodged}} or missed while '''Fiora''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}.
** {{tip|Block}} will not prevent a trigger.
** If the {{as|Vital|buzzword}} is triggered by {{ai|Lunge|Fiora}}, it can be {{tip|dodge|dodged}}, but it can't be {{tip|block|blocked}} and will trigger even if '''Fiora''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}.
* {{as|Vitals|buzzword}} are identified upon an enemy gaining {{tip|sight}} of '''Fiora''', and they are maintained while enemies maintain {{tip|sight}} of '''Fiora'''.
** If '''Fiora''' has no sight of the enemy (and is in the valid radius of her), the {{as|Vital|buzzword}} will not disappear.
** If the enemy has no sight of '''Fiora''', {{as|Vitals|buzzword}} are not identified.
params.tips: * While ''Duelist's Dance's'' {{as|Vitals|buzzword}} are a persistent effect, the identifying itself can be a powerful vision tool to control for [[Terminology#Gank|ambushes]] and [[Terminology#Flank|flanks]], as enemies cannot know '''Fiora''' is in range until they see her.

blurb.plain: Innate: Fiora challenges nearby enemy champions, calling out a direction from which she will try to strike their Vitals. A new Vital is called out after some time or if one is struck.

blurb2.plain: Striking a vital deals bonus true damage based on the target's maximum health, heals Fiora and grants her a burst of movement speed.

description.plain: Innate: Fiora identifies the Vitals of nearby enemy champions, marked as an arc around them in North-, East-, South- or Westward direction. Vitals take 1.75 seconds to become targetable and linger for 13.25 seconds afterwards while Fiora remains near the target, otherwise the Vital will disappear. After a Vital expires, Fiora identifies a new one on her target.

description2.plain: Dealing damage in the direction of a Vital will trigger it to deal bonus true damage equal to 3% (+ 4% per 100 bonus AD) of target's maximum health, heal Fiora for 35 – 100 (based on level), and grant her 20% – 50% (based on Grand Challenge's Rank) bonus movement speed that decays over 1.85 seconds.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Fiora}} {{tip|dashes}} in the target direction and then stabs a nearby enemy, dealing {{as|physical damage}} and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects.
params.blurb2: If she stabs a target, the cooldown is {{sti|ah|reduced}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Fiora''' {{tip|dashes}} in the target direction, then stabs a nearby enemy based on {{tt|a priority|See notes}}. ''Lunge'' can hit {{tip|structures}} and {{tip|ward|wards}}. Stabbing a target reduces ''Lunge's'' {{sti|cooldown}} by 50%.
params.description2: The stab deals {{as|physical damage}} and applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects.
params.description3: '''''Fiora''' can cast any of her {{tip|abilities}} during the dash. The target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be hit by this ability, unless it is a ward.''
params.notes:
* ''Lunge'' deals {{tip|basic damage}}, but also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as {{tip|spell damage}}.
* ''Lunge's'' dash speed is modified by her {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} at the time of cast:
** 1100 + {{as|350% '''bonus''' movement speed}}, capped at 1600 maximum dash speed if bonus movement speed is positive.
** 1100 + {{as|300% '''bonus''' movement speed}}, capped at 850 minimum dash speed if bonus movement speed is negative.
* The stab searches for targets in its radius and prioritizes in order of:
** Nearest enemy champion affected by {{ai|Grand Challenge|Fiora}} with a {{as|Vital|buzzword}} facing '''Fiora'''.
** Nearest enemy champion with their {{as|Vital|buzzword}} facing '''Fiora'''.
** Nearest enemy champion affected by {{ai|Grand Challenge|Fiora}}.
** Enemy champion with the lowest health percent out of all champions <20% remaining health.
** Nearest enemy champion, minion, or monster within 60% of the radius ({{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 252) with current health below ''Lunge's'' pre-mitigation damage.
** Nearest enemy champion in the radius check.
** Nearest champion in a {{tip|er|icononly = true}} rectangular check with 160 width and 450 units length backwards from '''Fiora's''' current facing direction, ignoring the normal radius check.
*** Turning '''Fiora's''' facing direction during the dash (e.g. by casting {{ai|Riposte|Fiora}}) can create some very long range hits opposite to her new facing direction, especially against targets with a large gameplay radius.{{bug}}
** Nearest enemy minion with current health below ''Lunge's'' pre-mitigation damage.
** Any nearest enemy minion or monster.
** Structures.
** Visible wards.
* ''Lunge'' cannot target [[jungle plants]].
* '''Fiora''' does not stab if the {{tip|dash}} is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}.
** {{si|Flash}} is disabled during the dash.
* ''Lunge'' does not interrupt issued orders.
** The user can freely input a movement or attack order during the dash to perform it after the dash ends.
** This behavior is the same regardless of whether ''Lunge'' hits an enemy or not.
* ''Lunge'' can be {{tip|dodge|dodged}} or {{tip|block|blocked}}, negating its damage.
* ''Lunge'' does not apply {{tip|on-attack}} effects but is special cased to stack {{tip|Energized}} upon hitting an enemy.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Fiora}} briefly parries all incoming damage and {{tip|debuff|debuffs}}, then stabs in a direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
params.blurb2: The stab {{tip|slow|slows}} the first enemy champion hit, or {{tip|stun|stuns}} them if '''Fiora''' parried a hostile {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} effect.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Fiora''' enters a defensive stance for {{fd|0.75}} seconds, during which she is {{tip|lockout|unable to act}}, prevents all incoming non-{{tip|turret}} damage, and gains {{tip|debuff}} immunity.
params.description2: Additionally, over the first {{fd|0.5}} seconds of the duration, '''Fiora''' poises to strike, after which she sends a shock with her sword in a line in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all enemies hit until colliding with an enemy champion.
params.description3: The enemy champion struck is also {{tip|slow|slowed}} and {{tip|cripple|crippled}} by 25% for 2 seconds. If ''Riposte'' negates at least one {{tt|hostile|Belonging to an enemy source}} {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} effect, '''Fiora''' {{tip|stun|stuns}} the target for the same duration instead.
params.notes:
* ''Riposte'' does not grant {{tip|invulnerability}} but instead reduces any incoming damage by 100% late into the damage event. Because of this, it interacts differently with effects triggered from damage:
** {{as|{{sti|Life steal}}}} and {{tip|Heal|healing}} based on damage dealt (Vamp) will still have effect even if the damage is ultimately ignored by ''Riposte''.
** {{tip|Shield|Shields}} will absorb damage before ''Riposte'' takes effect.
** '''Fiora''' cannot be {{tip|execute|executed}} by {{cai|Death from Below|Pyke}} during ''Riposte'', but she may by {{bi|Aspect of the Dragon}}.
* ''Riposte'' prevents {{cais|I|Azir}} {{tip|turret|Sun Disc}} damage. {{bug|2}}
* The debuff immunity encompasses:
** {{tip|Crowd control}}.
*** Note that this is not {{tip|crowd control immunity}}, and effects that look specifically for that will not consider ''Riposte'' (''e.g.,'' {{cai|R|Yasuo}} may not be cast on ''cc-immune'' targets but it can be cast while '''Fiora''' is in ''Riposte''). [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eOF0C6pKd9k]
** Debuffs from [[summoner spells]] such as {{sis|Exhaust}} damage reduction and all of {{sis|Ignite}} effects.
** {{tip|Persistent damage}} application.
** {{tip|Tether}} application (''e.g.,'' {{cai|R|Camille}} and {{cai|E|Illaoi}}), with the exception of {{cai|R|Malzahar}}. [https://www.reddit.com/r/leagueoflegends/comments/1aoiyhc/the_fiora_parry_of_a_lifetime/]
** Some mark applications (''e.g.,'' {{ai|I|Fiora}} and {{cai|Q|Zilean}}), but not some other (''e.g.,'' {{ai|R|Fiora}}, {{cai|I|Braum}} and {{ai|Q|Braum}}, {{cai|R|Caitlyn}}, {{cais|W|Kennen}} passive effect, {{cai|Q|Tahm Kench}}, and {{cai|R|Vi}}).
* If '''Fiora''' negates an {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} effect when the shock missile has struck an enemy champion already, the afflicted {{tip|slow}} and {{tip|cripple}} on the target will be removed and they will become {{tip|stun|stunned}} for a duration equal to the slow and cripple's remaining duration (effectively converting the slow/cripple into the stun).
** This event may only occur in the last {{fd|0.25}} seconds of ''Riposte's'' duration, during which '''Fiora''' retains her stance even while the missile is in-flight (timing of her stance and the missile's travel time overlap).
** Since the stun is applied equal to the remaining duration, it will last shorter than if it were applied normally.
*** This results in an unintended consequence of the stun duration being reduced by {{tip|tenacity}} twice, as the base stun duration would be equal to the reduced duration of the slow and cripple after tenacity is applied to it.{{bug|2}}
** The slow debuff on the target is however not removed properly, despite the slow itself being removed.{{bug}}
* ''Riposte'' will not negate {{tip|nearsight}}.
* {{tip|Immobilize|Immobilizing}} effects include those from {{ui|Blast Cone}} (only if triggered by an enemy) and {{tip|monster|epic monsters}}.
* ''Riposte'' does not count {{cai|R|K'Sante}} as an ''immobilizing'' effect. {{bug}}
* In the last {{fd|0.25}} seconds of ''Riposte's'' duration, '''Fiora''' cannot be [[Unit selection|selected]]. This is distinct from {{tip|untargetability}} and there are no known interactions beyond this.
* ''Riposte's'' effect prioritization is as follows:
** ''Riposte'' will negate effects before {{tip|spell shield|spell shields}}.
** {{cai|E|Morgana}} will negate {{tip|crowd control}} before ''Riposte''.
*** Being hit by a crowd control while affected by ''Black Shield'' means ''Riposte'' will not trigger its {{tip|stun}} empowerment condition, as it itself must negate the {{tip|immobilize}} and not any other external source.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will also prevent {{as|Vitals|buzzword}} from being triggered by ''Riposte's'' shock.
* The shock missile takes ~{{fd|0.25}} seconds to reach maximum range.
* The shock missile will be fired from wherever '''Fiora''' is after the first {{fd|0.5}} seconds of ''Riposte''.
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Fiora''' is performing ''Riposte'':

blurb.plain: Active: Fiora briefly parries all incoming damage and debuffs, then stabs in a direction, dealing magic damage to enemies hit.

blurb2.plain: The stab slows the first enemy champion hit, or stuns them if Fiora parried a hostile immobilizing effect.

description.plain: Active: Fiora enters a defensive stance for 0.75 seconds, during which she is unable to act, prevents all incoming non-turret damage, and gains debuff immunity.

description2.plain: Additionally, over the first 0.5 seconds of the duration, Fiora poises to strike, after which she sends a shock with her sword in a line in the target direction, dealing magic damage to all enemies hit until colliding with an enemy champion.

description3.plain: The enemy champion struck is also slowed and crippled by 25% for 2 seconds. If Riposte negates at least one hostile immobilizing effect, Fiora stuns the target for the same duration instead.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Fiora}} gains {{sti|range|'''bonus''' range}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for the next two attacks.
params.blurb2: The first attack {{tip|slow|slows}} the target, and the second attack will {{tip|critically strike}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Fiora''' empowers her next two [[basic attack]]s {{tip|on-attack}} within 4 seconds to gain {{sti|range|25 '''bonus''' range}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}.
params.description2: The first attack {{tip|slow|slows}} the target by 30% for 1 second but cannot {{tip|critically strike}}. The second attack will {{tip|critically strike}} for {{sti|critical damage modifiers|{{as|'''modified''' critical damage}}}}, including to {{tip|turrets|structures}}.
params.notes:
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will only block the slow from the first hit.
* {{iis|Sundered Sky}} Lightshield Strike's critical damage will override ''Bladework's'' if the resulting damage would be higher.
** This does not account for any critical damage bonuses that may affect Lightshield Strike.
* ''Bladework's'' first basic attack will slow even if it is {{tip|dodge|dodged}}, {{tip|block|blocked}} or {{tip|blind|missed}}.
* Neither ''Bladework'' attack will deal damage if it is {{tip|dodge|dodged}}, {{tip|block|blocked}} or {{tip|blind|missed}}.

blurb.plain: Active: Fiora gains bonus range and bonus attack speed for the next two attacks.

blurb2.plain: The first attack slows the target, and the second attack will critically strike.

description.plain: Active: Fiora empowers her next two basic attacks on-attack within 4 seconds to gain 25 bonus range and bonus attack speed.

description2.plain: The first attack slows the target by 30% for 1 second but cannot critically strike. The second attack will critically strike for modified critical damage, including to structures.

description3.plain: Bladework resets Fiora's basic attack timer.

params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Fiora}} reveals all {{as|Vitals|buzzword}} on an enemy champion and gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while near them.
params.blurb3: If '''Fiora''' triggers at least one {{as|Vital|buzzword}} before the target {{tip|death|dies}}, or triggers all four, she creates a {{ai|Grand Challenge 2|Fiora|''Victory Zone''}} which continually {{tip|heal|heals}} '''Fiora''' and her allies.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Fiora''' challenges the target enemy champion for 8 seconds, highlighting all four of their {{as|Vitals|buzzword}} after a {{fd|0.5}}-second delay. While in effect, ''{{ai|Duelist's Dance|Fiora}}'' does not identify new {{as|Vitals|buzzword}} on ''Grand Challenge's'' target, and unlike ''{{ai|Duelist's Dance|Fiora}}'', ''Grand Challenge's'' {{as|Vitals|buzzword}} will linger regardless of range.
params.description3: While near the target, '''Fiora''' gains ''{{ais|Duelist's Dance|Fiora}}'' {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
params.description4: If '''Fiora''' triggers at least one {{as|Vital|buzzword}} before the target {{tip|death|dies}}, or triggers all four otherwise, a ''{{ai|Grand Challenge 2|Fiora|Victory Zone}}'' is created on their death location for 5 seconds, which {{tip|heal|heals}} '''Fiora''' and all allies within the area every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
params.leveling4: {{st|Heal per Tick|{{ap|80/4 to 130/4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|70/4}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Heal per Second|{{ap|80 to 130}} {{as|(+ 70% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Maximum Heal|{{ap|80*5 to 130*5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|70*5}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
params.effect radius: {{dv|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|550|Movement speed radius, includes target radius}}|{{tt|600|Heal zone radius, does not include target radius}}}}
params.notes:
* ''Grand Challenge'' is dispelled instantly if targeting a [[decoy]].
** ''Grand Challenge'' cannot be cast on {{cai|Glory in Death|Sion}}.
* The damage of this ability scales with {{ai|Duelist's Dance|Fiora}}.
* Even if '''Fiora''' dies, the {{ai|Grand Challenge 2|Fiora|''Victory Zone''}} will trigger so long as she hit at least one {{as|Vital|buzzword}} and they die before the {{as|Vitals|buzzword}} wear off. 
** {{tip|Resurrection}} effects will not prevent the activation of the {{ai|Grand Challenge 2|Fiora|''Victory Zone''}}.
* The {{ai|Grand Challenge 2|Fiora|Victory Zone}} will not heal {{tip|untargetable}} units.
* '''Fiora''' will automatically attack the target upon casting if the target was selected while they were not in range of the ability.
* Attempting to cast ''Grand Challenge'' on a target already affected by it will incur a 1-second cooldown and a text saying that the ability cannot be stacked will pop out of the target.
params.tips: * If the target stays very close to terrain they can prevent '''Fiora''' from hitting all vitals.

blurb.plain: Passive: Duelist's Dance bonus movement speed is increased.

blurb2.plain: Active: Fiora reveals all Vitals on an enemy champion and gains bonus movement speed while near them.

blurb3.plain: If Fiora triggers at least one Vital before the target dies, or triggers all four, she creates a Victory Zone which continually heals Fiora and her allies.

description.plain: Passive: Duelist's Dance bonus movement speed is increased.

description2.plain: Active: Fiora challenges the target enemy champion for 8 seconds, highlighting all four of their Vitals after a 0.5-second delay. While in effect, Duelist's Dance does not identify new Vitals on Grand Challenge's target, and unlike Duelist's Dance, Grand Challenge's Vitals will linger regardless of range.

description3.plain: While near the target, Fiora gains Duelist's Dance bonus movement speed.

description4.plain: If Fiora triggers at least one Vital before the target dies, or triggers all four otherwise, a Victory Zone is created on their death location for 5 seconds, which heals Fiora and all allies within the area every 0.25 seconds.
